message.barklychemlab.lumen: A gentle garden glow settles over the world.
message.barklychemlab.echo: For a moment, every edge catches the light.
message.barklychemlab.orbit: The floor feels a little farther away.
message.barklychemlab.hush: A quiet current carries you onward.
message.barklychemlab.warmth: The village waves back. That was nice.
advancement.barklychemlab.fieldwork.desc: Prepare a notebook for recording curious finds.
advancement.barklychemlab.calibration.de: Make a lens for careful observation.
Turn exploration finds into a research insight.

tooltip.barklychemlab.sky_silk: Soft expedition fiber from a curious night encounter.
tooltip.barklychemlab.star_petals: Bright petals with an unusual shimmer.
tooltip.barklychemlab.resonance_core: A crafted focus for the research bench.
tooltip.barklychemlab.insight_fragment: A small milestone earned by combining field observations.

advancement.barklychemlab.dimension_surv: Carry an Insight Fragment from the Overworld into the Nether.
advancement.barklychemlab.outer_ledger.d: Bring an Insight Fragment to the End and back to your notes.

reaction.barklychemlab.fieldwork.1: The notebook is open. The first page is mostly doodles, which is a good start.
reaction.barklychemlab.fieldwork.2: Field notes acquired. A nearby pigeon has been appointed peer reviewer.
reaction.barklychemlab.fieldwork.3: Your research archive now has a cover and absolutely no filing system.
reaction.barklychemlab.calibration.1: Lens calibrated. The speck on it has been promoted to assistant researcher.
reaction.barklychemlab.calibration.2: That view is crisp enough to read the tiny warning label on the moon.
reaction.barklychemlab.calibration.3: The calibration chart is upside down. The results remain scientifically fabulous.
reaction.barklychemlab.insight.1: A new insight! It is glowing, so the lab has agreed to call it important.
reaction.barklychemlab.insight.2: Research complete. The clipboard has requested a tiny celebratory cape.
reaction.barklychemlab.insight.3: Your breakthrough has been reviewed by three bees and approved unanimously.
reaction.barklychemlab.profiles.1: All five profiles collected. The sample shelf is now a very polite rainbow.
reaction.barklychemlab.profiles.2: Archive complete. The labels are legible, which is the rarest material here.
reaction.barklychemlab.profiles.3: Every profile is catalogued. The filing cabinet has stopped making mysterious noises.
reaction.barklychemlab.dimension.1: Fieldwork in the Nether: your notebook now smells faintly of barbecue.
reaction.barklychemlab.dimension.2: You crossed dimensions for science. The ghast has submitted a travel reimbursement form.
reaction.barklychemlab.dimension.3: The Nether survey is filed. Lava was not interviewed due to scheduling conflicts.
tooltip.barklychemlab.kratom_archive: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; botanical research theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.kratom: A tiny forest ranger appears, stamps your notebook, and leaves a leaf-shaped receipt.
tooltip.barklychemlab.dxm_echo: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; echo and light theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.dxm: The echo arrives before the sound. The sound has filed a complaint.
tooltip.barklychemlab.ketamine_geometry: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; floating geometric theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.ketamine: The lab floor has become a very polite geometric diagram.
tooltip.barklychemlab.nitrous_cloud: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; brief cloud-hopping theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.nitrous: A cloud does one loop around your head and asks for applause.
tooltip.barklychemlab.mescaline_sun: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; sunlight and color theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.mescaline: The horizon has been recolored by a committee of extremely cheerful pixels.
tooltip.barklychemlab.twocb_prism: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; prism and colorwave theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.twocb: A prism tide rolls through the lab. The clipboard needs sunglasses.
tooltip.barklychemlab.mephedrone_spark: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; brief cartoon speed and spark theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.mephedrone: A cartoon comet zips past carrying your missing pencil.
tooltip.barklychemlab.ghb_tide: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; underwater glide theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.ghb: A bubblecurrent gently escorts a fish-shaped thought past the window.
tooltip.barklychemlab.benzodiazepine_lan: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; gentle floating-lantern theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.benzodiaze: A paper lantern floats by and reminds everyone to take the slow route.
tooltip.barklychemlab.barbiturate_archiv: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; quiet archive theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.barbiturat: The archive becomes quiet enough to hear a book turn its own page.
tooltip.barklychemlab.oxycodone_moon: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; moonlit protection theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.oxycodone: A moon-shaped guardian light appears, then politely returns to the sky.
tooltip.barklychemlab.diphenhydramine_mo: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; gentle mothlight theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.diphenhydr: A moth made of pixels circles the lamp and forgets why it came over.
tooltip.barklychemlab.alcohol_campfire: Fictional Minecraft-only experience; campfire-color theme. Does not describe real-world effects or use.
message.barklychemlab.profile.alcohol: The campfire fizz pops once. A marshmallow nearby applauds.
advancement.barklychemlab.experience_col: Collect the five starter fantasy profile artifacts.
advancement.barklychemlab.expanded_archi: Collect every additional profile inspired by an uncovered pack category.

message.barklychemlab.profile.pcp: The mirror maze folds into a neat little paper map. Nobody remembers drawing it.
message.barklychemlab.profile.methylphen: A tiny clockwork bird zips through the lab, then returns your screwdriver.
reaction.barklychemlab.archive.1: The expanded archive is complete. Every label made it through peer review.
reaction.barklychemlab.archive.2: All profile artifacts catalogued. The filing cabinet has requested a vacation.
reaction.barklychemlab.archive.3: Two dozen strange little profiles, one very proud notebook.
reaction.barklychemlab.outer.1: The End survey is filed. The dragon declined to sign the clipboard.
reaction.barklychemlab.outer.2: You brought a research note home from the End. The portal says, “nice paperwork.”
reaction.barklychemlab.outer.3: Field trip complete. The stars have been added to the bibliography.
